content: Letter of Qāżīzāda Rūmī continued: he mentions meeting Ibn Turka in Herat (MK: during the latter's second trial?) and reminds him of a promise to visit him in Samarkand; he thanks Ibn Turka for the copy of his R. Basmala and remarks on the refined comportment of Ẓahīr al-Dīn, who brought the treatise and conveyed Ibn Turka's greetings (edition in P.2.2).
refers_to_primary: Letter of Qāżīzāda Rūmī, MS Majlis 10196 f. 153b
